extName.description: The extension's name, shown in the browser toolbar and extensions management page.

extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers, and silently closes popup/redirect tabs, without nag screens.
extDescription.description: The extension's short description, shown on the extensions management page and store listing.

popupOnboardingCard.message: Moat blocks ads and trackers automatically. Use the switch below to pause it on a site, or Settings to fine-tune.

popupBudgetNotice.message: Some filter lists are off -- the browser's shared rule limit is full.

popupProtectionNone.message: Nothing to block on this page

popupPausedSuffix.message: . Reload the page to see it unblocked.

popupLoadError.message: Couldn't load status. Try reopening the popup.

popupReportError.message: Couldn't open the report page. Try again.

optionsTagline.message: Blocks ads, trackers, and hijacked popups.

optionsMasterToggleHint.message: Turn all blocking on or off, everywhere.

optionsCookiesToggleHint.message: Stops sites from tracking you as you move from one to the next.

optionsWebrtcToggleHint.message: Keeps a website from seeing your real IP address if you're using a VPN.

optionsFingerprintToggleHint.message: Randomly tweaks details about your device that sites use to recognize you across visits. Can occasionally break a CAPTCHA.

optionsFingerprintRotateToggleLabel.message: Use a new disguise each time you restart

optionsFingerprintRotateToggleHint.message: Creates a new browser disguise every time you restart, instead of keeping the same one. This way sites can't use it to recognize you over time.

optionsGrayscaleToggleHint.message: Fades in-stream video ads, like YouTube's, to grayscale while they play.

optionsFeedScanToggleHint.message: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube as you scroll.

optionsConsentRejectToggleHint.message: Clicks “reject” or “decline” on common consent banners for you.

optionsCnameToggleHint.message: Some trackers disguise themselves as part of the site you're visiting. This finds and blocks them anyway.

optionsCnameChromeDohHint.message: On Chrome, this checks disguised trackers using Cloudflare's public lookup service, and may miss the very first one it finds -- it catches every one after that. Firefox does this itself, more privately, and catches every one from the start.

optionsLiveListHint.message: Keeps the list of known popup and redirect sites up to date, once a day.

optionsExceptionsHint.message: Moat is completely turned off on these sites, and any pages under them.

optionsFilterBudgetWarning.message: Some of Moat's filter lists couldn't turn on. Browsers limit how many blocking rules extensions can use in total, and that limit is easy to hit if you have another ad blocker or privacy extension running too. Try turning one of them off, or switch off a list below.

optionsFilterBudgetDetail.message: Your browser says $COUNT$ rule slots are left for all your extensions combined. Still low after turning off other extensions and reloading Moat? Turn off a list below -- Annoyances or Cookie Notices first.

optionsFilterBudgetDropped.message: Turned off for now to stay within your browser's rule limit: $NAMES$.

optionsIndividualListsHint.message: Turn each list on or off yourself. Changing any one switches your filtering level to Custom.

optionsBlockedSitesHint.message: Always block these sites, whatever the filter lists say.

optionsAllowedSitesHint.message: Never block these sites, even when a filter list matches.

optionsHiddenElementsHint.message: Elements you hid with the “Block an element” tool. Remove one to bring it back.

optionsDimmedElementsHint.message: Elements you grayed out with the picker. Remove one to restore it.

optionsTrackersEmpty.message: No trackers found on the last tab you had open.

optionsTrackersUnsupported.message: This detailed tracker list only works in Chrome for now -- Firefox doesn't support it yet.

optionsPrivacyIntro.message: Everything here stays on your device -- none of it is sent to Moat's developer. Only two optional features (breach checking and settings sync) ever talk to anyone else; see the privacy policy for details.

optionsBackupIntro.message: Save your settings to a file, or load one back in later. Your fingerprint-protection ID is never included, so it won't carry over.

optionsSyncToggleHint.message: Copies your settings using your browser's own sync account, like your Google or Firefox account. A new install picks them up once, but editing settings on two devices at the same time won't merge -- one will overwrite the other.

optionsSyncStatusFailed.message: Couldn't sync your settings ($WHEN$) -- you may have too many custom rules or sites for your browser's sync storage. They're still saved on this device.

presetHintLite.message: Like Essential, without the largest security list.

presetHintStrict.message: Every list, plus the privacy toggles above.

presetHintCustom.message: A mix you've set up yourself.

optionsLiveStatusFailed.message: Last attempt failed ($WHEN$) -- still using the built-in list until the next try.

optionsImportedInvalid.message: That file doesn't look like a valid Moat settings export.

leakedPasswordWarning.message: This password has appeared in a known data breach.

optionsLeakedPasswordToggleHint.message: Warns if a password you type has appeared in a known breach. Only a short piece of its hash ever leaves your device.

popupPermissionGuardIntro.message: Moat's permission guard is blocking prompts on this site:

optionsPermissionGuardCameraToggleHint.message: Sets every site's camera prompt to blocked by default, so a page can't surprise you with it on load. Allow a specific site from the popup when you trust it.

optionsPermissionGuardMicrophoneToggleHi.message: Sets every site's microphone prompt to blocked by default. Allow a specific site from the popup when you trust it.

optionsPermissionGuardLocationToggleHint.message: Sets every site's location prompt to blocked by default. Allow a specific site from the popup when you trust it.

optionsSearchSlopToggleHint.message: Hides search results that match a small, curated list of content-farm domains. Each hidden batch stays one click away behind a "Show" link. Off by default, since this list can misfire in ways a fixed ad-network list won't.

optionsProtectionDesc.message: What Moat blocks, and what it leaves alone. Everything here runs on your device.

optionsFingerprintDrawerDesc.message: Randomly tweaks details about your device that sites use to recognize you across visits.

optionsFingerprintCaution.message: Can occasionally break a CAPTCHA or a bank's device check. If a site misbehaves, pause this first.

optionsCnameDrawerDesc.message: Some trackers disguise themselves as part of the site you're visiting.

optionsSearchSlopDrawerDesc.message: Hides search results that match a small, curated list of content-farm domains.

optionsSearchSlopCaution.message: Each hidden batch stays one click away behind a "Show" link. Off by default, since this list can misfire in ways a fixed ad-network list won't.

optionsLeakedPasswordDrawerDesc.message: Warns if a password you type has appeared in a known breach.

optionsLeakedPasswordCaution.message: Only a short piece of its hash ever leaves your device.

optionsPermissionGuardMergedDesc.message: Sets every site's camera, microphone, and location prompts to blocked by default, so a page can't surprise you with one on load. Allow a specific site from the popup when you trust it.

optionsFilterListsDesc.message: The rule sets Moat compiles into the browser's own blocker. All six ship inside the extension — nothing is fetched to make them work.

optionsCustomRulesDesc.message: Everything you've hidden yourself with the element picker. These override the filter lists and never leave your browser.

optionsRuleAddedMeta.message: Added $DAYS$ days ago · hidden $COUNT$ times since

optionsRuleStaleMeta.message: Hasn't matched in 30 days — the site probably changed

optionsTrackersDesc.message: Which companies tried to follow you, and how far they got. Counted on your device from the browser's own match data — this list is never uploaded.
